payload.title: Prior-art survey: Make a single shot against all childhood diseases (part 1 of 3)
payload.criteria: Prior-art survey part 1 of 3 for "Make a single shot against all childhood diseases". Main KPI: "130,000,000 children per year vaccinated". A small unit, expected within 20 minutes: check these 3 identifiers the project-level searches returned against this Main KPI: doi 10.26226/morressier.5b519f6bb1b87b000ecf14de; doi 10.1021/acs.jproteome.2c00023.s001; doi 10.5040/9781666999662.ch-007. Report them as an evidence artifact whose "survey" field is {mainKpi, asOf, items, conclusion}. mainKpi is the Main KPI above, exactly. asOf is the survey date (YYYY-MM-DD). Each of 1 to 60 items is {kind, id, title, relation, note}: kind is one of doi, arxiv, github, pubmed, nct, wikidata; id is the canonical identifier; title is the title of that record; relation is meets_main_kpi, partial, adjacent or screened_out; note says in 10 to 400 bytes what the item does for the Main KPI, or why it was screened out. Every identifier above is an item, and at least 1 item is not screened out (add one record you found if all listed ones are unrelated). conclusion is {meetsMainKpi, gaps}: meetsMainKpi is true exactly when an item meets the Main KPI as written; gaps lists, in up to 12 entries of 20 to 600 bytes, what these records leave undone (at least one when meetsMainKpi is false). Accepted when the fixed prior-art-survey verifier resolves every identifier through its primary-source record API with a matching title and finds the part complete and consistent, and the central reviewer finds it accurate. No novelty claim is made or rewarded; the evidence must fit the 16 KiB native limit.
